posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: Not that this is helpful but SotM is not the only app having this issue with In App Purchases(IAP).    The main way they seem to reproduce it is when they try to download an IAP and don't have the space for it.   After that even if you do clear enough space you still will get the error.   It's an issue Apple is looking into further as it has even affected apps that haven't been modified in years and more recent ones.

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
I have some great news! Today, Apple has released iOS 9.2 to the public. This update has many bug fixes, including a fix for the “SKERRORDOMAIN ERROR 0” issue some of you have experienced.

You can update your iPad by opening the Settings app and selecting General. Tap Software Update, and your iPad should find the iOS 9.2 update and be able to install it.

After updating to iOS 9.2 the Get Expansion Packs screen in Sentinels should start working properly again. If you continue to have a problem, please let me know.

We appreciate your patience and are glad that the ordeal is finally over! We hope you enjoy your new content, and look forward to getting Shattered Timelines in your hands soon!
